notes: The first visitor creates the instance administrator: open the site right after install, sign up, then click "Claim this instance". Until then anyone who reaches the URL can claim it.

Paperclip runs in authenticated mode with private exposure, upstream's own Docker default; it is the mode that allows the browser claim. Public exposure would disable the claim and fail local stdio MCP closed, so it is not used.
PAPERCLIP_PUBLIC_URL is the url key: the auth base URL, callbacks and the allowed hostnames derive from it, so a domain change or a new certificate re-renders it.
